stratagem.name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
stratagem.lore: Knowing well their duty to shatter the foe’s lines, these warriors strike with devastating strength.
stratagem.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.

stratagem.name: STAND UNYIELDING
stratagem.lore: Ground claimed by Gravis-clad Adeptus Astartes cannot be taken back with ease.
stratagem.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagem.name: SUPPRESSION VOLLEYS
stratagem.lore: Laying down hails of heavy fire, these warriors pin or drive back the foe.
stratagem.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit has shot.
stratagem.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
